name: Pixel Buds
author: Ryan Doupe
description: Pixel Buds Pro in the Omarchy bar — battery per bud and case, ANC / Transparency / Adaptive, and device + sound controls (multipoint, speech detection, on-head, EQ, balance). Event-driven: the icon appears the moment your buds connect. Needs pbpctrl (AUR); the popup walks you through installing it if it’s missing. Optional: bind a hotkey to omarchy-shell io.github.rdoupe.pixelbuds cycleAnc / toggle.

barWidget.description: Battery per bud and case, listening modes, and an Advanced section with device toggles, EQ, balance and mono. Needs pbpctrl (AUR).

schema.label: Poll interval while the panel is closed (seconds)
Hide the icon while no Pixel Buds are connected
